entries.text: What IS this? It’s like a crystal trying to be a\nflower. It’s completely blocked up the path...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_01

entries.text: Yeah, we’re not going any further with this in\nthe way.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_01

entries.text: Hey, what about Whatchama-don, that Pokémon\nyou ride on! Couldn’t it smash through?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_02

entries.text: Let’s give it a go!
entries.label: sdc02_0262_select_01

entries.text: I’m not so sure...
entries.label: sdc02_0262_select_02

entries.text: Hold on, hold on! PLEASE, hold on![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_01

entries.text: This is quite likely a manifestation of pure\nTerastal energy...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_02

entries.text: We have no idea what might happen if we try to\ndestroy it with brute force.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_03

entries.text: OK, so what do we do, then?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_02

entries.text: Gli... Gli... Gli...
entries.label: sdc02_0262_poke_01

entries.text: There are Pokémon all the way down here?![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_06

entries.text: And what’s going on with this one? It seems to\nbe charged with some kind of strange energy...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_07

entries.text: Hey, get back! You know you’re no good in a\nbattle, Ms. Briar![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Kiki— No, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
You
should
handle
this![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_04

entries.text: MORAAAAAA!!!
entries.label: sdc02_0262_poke_02

entries.text: Whoa, it disappeared.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_03

entries.text: Did knocking out that sparkling Pokémon make\nthe crystal flower disappear?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_06

entries.text: It’s just like in that report we found earlier...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_08

entries.text:
What we just witnessed was a Pokémon wielding
the powers of each and every type.\c
That means it must have had the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Stellar[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Tera Type[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_09

entries.text: Uh...so what’s all that mean?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_07

entries.text: Wait, was THAT supposed to be the so-called\nhidden treasure we’re looking for?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_08

entries.text: I can’t say for certain, but...no. I don’t think so.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_10

entries.text: The professor’s notes said the hidden treasure of\nArea Zero is slumbering in crystal form.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_11

entries.text: The Glimmora you just fought off doesn’t fully fit\nthat description, so I don’t think it’s the Pokémon\r\nthe professor called Terapagos.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_12

entries.text: Well, the only way to know if it was the hidden\ntreasure or not is to keep going.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_05

entries.text: Come on.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_06

entries.text:
I bet the path’ll open up if we can defeat that
sparkly Pokémon up there.\c
Well? What’re you waiting for? Hop on your
Whatchama-don and get over to that cliff![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_sister_npc

entries.text: If that sparkling Pokémon wasn’t so far away,\nI’d make quick work of ’em.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_brother_npc

entries.text:
It seems we’ve found another one of those
crystal flowers...\c
Could the Terastal energy that’s saturating the air
be condensing into a crystallized form?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc02_0262_bbteacher_npc
